usedFor: vPlan holds cards and collections, and MailerLite adds the people involved as subscribers with “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New or Changed Comment” in vPlan, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A comment shows someone engaging with the work, so they join a list you can email.

watchOut: “New or Updated Card” fires on updates as well as new cards, so the same person can run twice.
